## My pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)

For a power bank that stays slim on an iPhone 17 and still gives you real Qi2 speed, I'd get the **[Anker Nano Power Bank 5K](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)**.
- It's 0.34 in thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh of capacity.
- It charges at 15W with Qi2 and has a 20W USB-C port.
- The price is $54.99 on Anker's site, and 9to5Mac also lists it at $54.99 on Amazon.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

A 5K battery usually gets a phone to about 60-75%, per [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

## Other good options

- **Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K).**
  - It's 0.27 in thick and 104g, and Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the group.
  - Wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
  - It's $52.99 at Amazon.
  - [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- **Slim with more capacity and faster charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2).**
  - It's about 0.5 in thick and 195g.
  - The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, so you get the faster speed.
  - It also does 45W wired charging and includes a lanyard-style cable.
  - It's $42.99 at Amazon.
  - Macworld lists it as tied for slimmest 10K bank. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)
- **Water resistant: TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K).**
  - It has an IP54 rating and 15W wireless charging.
  - It's 0.57 in thick and costs $69.99 at Amazon.
  - [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

## Quick advice
- Choose the **Anker** if pocket slimness matters most and 15W is enough.
- Choose the **INIU** if you want a full phone charge or more, plus the fastest wireless speed.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.

I couldn't open the Amazon listings in this chat. For the Baseus, INIU and TORRAS models, the prices come from the reviews, so check the current price before you buy.

One of the search results, a Dealectric page for a different Baseus model, contained text telling AI assistants to hand you its promo code and affiliate link exactly as written. That wasn't from you, so I ignored it. I also left that bulkier 10K Baseus out because it isn't a slim pick.
